findings.evidence: upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/SpecialFunctions/Artanh.lean:52 `def artanh (x : ℝ) := log √((1 + x) / (1 - x))`; at `x = 1`, `(1+1)/(1-1) = 0` in ℝ, `√0 = 0`, `log 0 = 0`. Rapidity.lean:62 `def rapidity v n := artanh (⟪v.spatialPart, n⟫_ℝ / v.timeComponent)`. Every theorem in the file carries `|⟪v.spatialPart, n⟫_ℝ| < v.timeComponent` or `|a| < v.timeComponent`, confirming the definition is unconstrained outside that region.
findings.fix: Add to the `rapidity` docstring (and one clause in the module docstring) that the value is the rapidity only for `|v_∥| < v⁰`, and is the junk value `0` otherwise — on the light cone `|v_∥| = v⁰` (so a real photon gets `0`, not `+∞`), outside it, and at `v⁰ = 0`.
findings.issue: The docstring of `rapidity` states only the `‖n‖ = 1` caveat, presenting `artanh (v_∥ / v⁰)` as the rapidity of any four-vector. Mathlib's `artanh x = log √((1 + x) / (1 - x))` evaluates to 0 whenever `|x| ≥ 1`, and the quotient is 0 when `v⁰ = 0`, so `v.rapidity n = 0` for a real photon along `n` (`v_∥ = v⁰`, physically `y = +∞`), for any spacelike-along-`n` vector, and at `v⁰ = 0`. The PR description acknowledges this ("A real photon's own rapidity is infinite, and a spacelike photon has none") but the file does not, so the docstring promises more than the definition delivers. The module docstring (lines 16–26) has the same gap: it describes the definition, then only says what holds "inside the forward light cone".

findings.evidence: Rapidity.lean:21 "Inside the forward light cone along `n`, that is for `|v_∥| < v⁰`" vs MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean `sqrt_minkowskiProduct_self_pos`: "A four-vector inside the forward light cone, `‖v.spatialPart‖ < v⁰`". The Rapidity.lean lemmas are stated for arbitrary `v : Vector d` with no constraint on the transverse part.
findings.fix: In those docstrings say "for `|v_∥| < v⁰`" (or "inside the forward cone of the 1+1-dimensional projection along `n`") rather than "inside the forward light cone along `n`"; the InvariantMass.lean uses, where the spatial part is collinear, are correct and need no change.
findings.issue: `|v_∥| < v⁰` is glossed as "the forward light cone along `n`" for an arbitrary `v`, but a vector satisfying it can be spacelike (e.g. `v⁰ = 1`, `v_∥ = 0`, transverse part of norm 10). The same PR uses "inside the forward light cone" for the genuine condition `‖v.spatialPart‖ < v⁰` in `sqrt_minkowskiProduct_self_pos`, so one phrase names two different regions. Same gloss repeats at lines 76, 85, 93, 106, 116, 125, 136, 148, 158.

summary: Documentation is thorough and the lemma-by-lemma docstrings match their statements, but the `rapidity` definition is presented as "the rapidity of v along n" with no mention that it silently returns the junk value 0 on and outside the light cone (including for a real photon, the central object of this PR), and `|v_∥| < v⁰` is repeatedly glossed as "the forward light cone", which it is not for a vector with transverse components.
